sections.title: Introduction
sections.html:
Introduction

Website design can feel overwhelming when you start with a blank screen. This ebook gives you 50 ready-to-use prompts that help you move faster from idea to website concept. Each prompt is written so beginners can copy, paste, and build with VS Code and AI coding tools.

Use this book as a shortcut for creative direction, layout planning, content structure, and professional web design ideas. You can use the prompts exactly as written or customize them for your own niche, client, or brand.

sections.title: Beginner Guide: How to Copy and Paste the Code
sections.html:
Beginner Guide: How to Copy and Paste the Code

Step 1: Install VS Code

Download and install Visual Studio Code on your computer.

Step 2: Create a New Folder

Create a folder on your desktop, such as My Website.

Step 3: Open the Folder

Open VS Code, click File, then Open Folder, and choose your website folder.

Step 4: Create 3 Files

Create index.html, styles.css, and script.js. Keep the names exactly the same.

Step 5: Paste the Code

Paste HTML into index.html, CSS into styles.css, and JavaScript into script.js.

Step 6: Preview

Install Live Server. Right-click index.html and choose Open with Live Server.

Step 7: Customize

Replace the sample text, colors, images, prices, and contact details with your own.

Step 8: Save Often

Press Ctrl + S after each change. Refresh the browser if needed.

sections.title: How to Use the Prompts
sections.html:
How to Use the Prompts

Choose one prompt, copy the full text, and paste it into your AI coding tool inside VS Code. Ask the tool to create the three files for you. Start with one project at a time so the code stays organized. After the website works, customize it for your brand or client.

For best results, add details such as your business name, target audience, preferred colors, sections you want, and whether you want HTML/CSS/JS or a React/Next.js version.
